categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Tuopu Group primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of automotive parts. Its main product lines include automotive NVH damping systems, interior and exterior systems, lightweight body components, intelligent cockpit parts, thermal management systems, chassis systems, air suspension systems, and intelligent driving systems. Additionally, the company has established an electric drive division focusing on embodied intelligent robot components, aiming to create a new growth curve.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes forward-looking R&D with integrated capabilities in materials, mechanics, electronics, and software. It employs advanced manufacturing processes such as rubber injection molding, multi-component fiber forming, injection molding, forging, casting, stamping, welding, high-precision CNC machining, SMT patching, and automated assembly lines. Digital factory initiatives include MES management, virtual simulation (DFM), AI visual inspection, AGV logistics, and RFID traceability, supporting Industry 4.0 smart manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tuopu Group serves major domestic and international intelligent electric vehicle manufacturers and traditional OEMs. Key domestic customers include Huawei-Seres, Li Auto, NIO, Chery, Great Wall, Xiaomi, BYD, Geely, and XPeng. Internationally, it collaborates with innovative US EV companies such as Rivian, Ford, GM, Stellantis, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. The company’s products are integrated into new energy vehicles and intelligent driving systems globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with manufacturing bases in Ningbo, Chongqing, Wuhan, and other automotive clusters. Internationally, it has production facilities and subsidiaries in the United States, Brazil, Malaysia, Poland, Mexico, Thailand, Sweden, and Canada. It is actively expanding capacity in Mexico, Poland, and Thailand to serve local markets and mitigate trade risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tuopu Group operates primarily as a midstream automotive parts supplier, providing system-level modules and components to OEMs. It integrates vertically by acquiring companies like Wuhu Changpeng Automotive Parts to enhance interior product market share and supply chain capacity. The company’s platform-based product lines and Tier0.5 cooperation model position it as a strategic partner in the automotive supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes platform-based product expansion, technological innovation, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D focuses include air suspension systems, intelligent cockpit projects, brake-by-wire (IBS), steer-by-wire (EPS), electric drive systems, and embodied intelligent robot actuators. It invests heavily in digital factories, virtual simulation, and AI technologies to enhance quality and efficiency. The strategic goal is to become a world-class automotive parts supplier and a leader in intelligent electric vehicle and robotics sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive components and systems to OEM customers. The company employs a Tier0.5 innovative business model that enhances single-vehicle supply value and fosters strategic partnerships. Revenue streams include product sales domestically and internationally, with increasing contributions from high-value automotive electronics and robot electric drive components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tuopu Group is positioned as a leading Chinese automotive parts supplier with a broad product platform and strong R&D capabilities. It competes with both domestic and international automotive component manufacturers, leveraging its integrated product lines and Tier0.5 cooperation model to build high entry barriers. Its early adoption of forward-looking R&D and global manufacturing footprint provide competitive advantages in the evolving intelligent electric vehicle market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 26.6 billion, a 35% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3 billion, up nearly 40%. Total assets reached RMB 37.5 billion, growing 22%, with equity increasing by 42%. The company maintains a healthy asset-liability ratio of 47.84% and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, supported by successful refinancing raising nearly RMB 3.5 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tuopu Group offers a comprehensive, platform-based product portfolio covering eight major automotive systems, enabling one-stop, modular solutions for OEMs. Its unique Tier0.5 cooperation model enhances customer value through rapid response and deep collaboration. The company’s strong R&D integration across materials, mechanics, electronics, and software, combined with advanced digital manufacturing and global footprint, differentiates it as a trusted partner capable of delivering innovative, high-quality, and cost-effective automotive components.
